name: pixellence
description: Particle simulation sandbox game with seasons, weather, and living creatures

scripts.test:ios: cd ios/App && xcodebuild test -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme AppUITests -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -resultBundlePath ../../test-results/xcuitest.xcresult 2>&1 | tail -50
scripts.test:ios:ipad: cd ios/App && xcodebuild test -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme AppUITests -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPad Air 11-inch (M3)' -resultBundlePath ../../test-results/xcuitest-ipad.xcresult 2>&1 | tail -50
